turns.question: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, how much higher in EUR was the average non-cancelled order amount of customers who signed up before 2026 than that of customers who signed up in 2026?
turns.answer: Between 17 August and 10 October 2026, the average non-cancelled order amount was 102.67 EUR for customers who signed up before 2026 (the only pre-2026 signup year with orders in that window is 2024) and 41.00 EUR for customers who signed up in 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
